purpose: Printed manual rasterized at 300 DPI into an image-only PDF (no text layer).
why: OCR baseline. Gives the character error rate; also proves hidden-text detection does not fire on pages that only carry an OCR layer.

blocks.text: The pool size of component Q001 is 40 minutes. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
The heap ceiling of component X002 is 70 minutes. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic.
The retry budget of component Z003 is 80 requests. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The queue depth of component W004 is 33 megabytes. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment. It is documented here because several teams depend on it.
The cache ttl of component V005 is 20 minutes. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment.
The rate limit of component K006 is 94 minutes. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart.
The cache ttl of component Q007 is 41 minutes. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic.
The pool size of component X008 is 50 seconds. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart.
The rate limit of component Z009 is 37 messages. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows.
